predictions.priority_justification: The Windows XP look and feel may improve user familiarity but is not critical for system functionality. GUI features can be adjusted to maintain intuitive use.

predictions.text: Quando o jogador atacante executa um arremesso, o produto deverá simular o som de um navio no mar.
predictions.text_en: When the offensive player takes a shot  the product shall simulate the sound of a ship at sea.
predictions.justification: The requirement describes a specific functionality related to the simulation of a sound, which is a typical characteristic of functional requirements.
predictions.priority_justification: The sound simulation adds value but can be removed with minor impact to the core functionality of the product.

predictions.text: O site deve usar Flash para fornecer animação na página inicial.
predictions.text_en: The website should use Flash to provide animation on the home page.
predictions.justification: This requirement specifies a specific technology (Flash) for providing animations, which is a functional aspect of the website.
predictions.priority_justification: Flash is outdated and not supported by modern browsers. Using it may negatively impact user experience and accessibility.
